narrative:
Sport Holding net sales in the Q3 Forecast are NOK 6,780M: Intersport NOK 4,136M (61%), Sport 1 NOK 1,898M (28%) and Anton Sport NOK 746M (11%). Web shops are 14% of sales.

Sales are planned as transactions × average basket per store, brand and channel. The ML forecast proposes both from 33 months of POS history; store and chain controllers accept or override, with a full audit trail.

Key risk: ski & winter in Trøndelag has 2.1 weeks of cover before week 50, with NOK 8.6M of sales at risk.

signals.title: Ski stock cover in Trøndelag at 2.1 weeks before the winter peak
signals.source: SDP Inventory & Stockout Intelligence — store stock × ML demand forecast
signals.excerpt: Intersport Trondheim City Syd and Solsiden have 2.1 weeks of alpine and cross-country cover against a 6-week target before week 50. Estimated sales at risk NOK 8.6M (NOK 3.2M gross margin) unless DC stock is re-allocated from Oslo this week.

signals.title: Stockouts cost NOK 23.8M of gross margin YTD
signals.source: SDP lost-sales model — POS demand vs on-shelf availability, Jan–Sep 2026
signals.excerpt: Lost sales from stockouts are NOK 64.2M YTD (NOK 23.8M gross margin): Intersport NOK 15.0M, Sport 1 NOK 6.4M, Anton Sport NOK 2.4M of margin. On-shelf availability is 93.4% against a 96% target.
